# SORA - St George's Online Research Archive

> > SORA is St George's University of London's institutional open-access repository for research publications, enabling discovery and access to SGUL scholarly outputs across multiple research institutes.

SORA serves as the central platform for SGUL to manage, preserve, and disseminate research publications and academic outputs. The repository supports open-access scholarship and provides multiple discovery pathways including browsing by year, keywords, research divisions, and authors.

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to SORA](https://openaccess.sgul.ac.uk): SORA: St George's Online Research Archive for SGUL research publications
- [FAQs and Contacts](https://openaccess.sgul.ac.uk/help): FAQ and contact information for SORA institutional repository support

## Browse & Discover

- [Browse Items](https://openaccess.sgul.ac.uk/view): Browse and search SORA open-access research publications and items
- [Browse by Year](https://openaccess.sgul.ac.uk/view/year): Browse SORA academic publications organized by publication year
- [Browse by Keywords](https://openaccess.sgul.ac.uk/view/keywords): Browse SORA research by subject keywords and classification
- [Browse by Author](https://openaccess.sgul.ac.uk/view/creators): Browse SORA research publications by author name and affiliation
- [Browse by Research Institute](https://openaccess.sgul.ac.uk/view/divisions): Browse SGUL research by institutes including Cardiovascular and Infection
- [Latest Additions](https://openaccess.sgul.ac.uk/cgi/latest_tool): View latest 20 recent additions to SORA medical research repository
